title: Yagai maruhi: Etchi nozoite
original_title: 野外(秘)エッチ 覗いて
overview: Nariko, a university student recuperating from a broken leg at her family's seaside guesthouse, is left in charge of the place while her parents go on a trip to Hawaii. There, she meets a man who arrives carrying an old photograph. The person in the picture is a woman Nariko knows well...
